problem: allow() now unconditionally appends now to the per-key deque even when the request is denied, so rejected calls are recorded in the sliding window just like accepted ones.
suggested_fix: Only append now when allowed is True (restore if allowed: q.append(now)), so the deque stays bounded by limit and denied retries don't extend their own lockout.

problem: There is no test anywhere in the repo for SlidingWindowLimiter, so this regression shipped with no automated guard against it.
suggested_fix: Add a regression test asserting that after N > limit calls for one key within a window, the per-key queue length stays <= limit.
